notes: Both apps are now very light: idle Spindle ~0.1% CPU / 30 MB (it was using a third of a core), Sleeve ~0.1% / 15 MB. Spindle's playing indicator and spinning record run on Core Animation, polling is event-driven, and Sleeve only scans every app when something launches or quits. Spindle's Liquid Glass is now genuinely clear: see-through, with Apple's lensing edges, fading to frosted on the slider.
